context: Evaluates whether the agent separates the overall proceed verdict from a distinct, unrelated gap surfaced by one reviewer role, recording each as its own artifact.

checklist.name: Grounds before positions
checklist.description: Uses rule count, duplication, and cron facts before assigning roles

checklist.name: Parallel spawn with identical brief
checklist.description: All three roles spawned together with the same brief

checklist.name: Correct main verdict
checklist.description: Main verdict is proceed or proceed_with_modification on the consolidation question

checklist.name: Cron-overlap gap identified
checklist.description: The Migration/Risk role's cron-overlap observation is explicitly identified as a separate concrete gap

checklist.name: Gap not treated as resolved by verdict
checklist.description: The agent does not treat the cron overlap as fixed just because the main verdict is proceed

checklist.name: Two distinct artifacts produced
checklist.description: A finding for the main verdict and a separate known-issue for the cron gap are both produced

checklist.name: No merging into main finding
checklist.description: The cron-overlap gap is not folded into the main finding as a footnote

checklist.name: No chat-only mention
checklist.description: The gap is not left only as a spoken aside ('worth flagging separately') without an artifact

checklist.name: Explicit persistence ask per artifact
checklist.description: User is asked explicitly before each of the two artifacts is written

checklist.name: Verdict names winning argument
checklist.description: The synthesis states which argument (Advocate's or Skeptic's) held up, not just a bare recommendation
